title.zh: China targets 2030 for its national blockchain network buildout
title.en: China targets 2030 for its national blockchain network buildout

current_state.zh: China's new five-year informatization plan sets a 2030 target for largely completing a national blockchain network, with focused deployments in Yangtze River Delta trade and finance and large-scale use in Chengdu-Chongqing manufacturing and agriculture.
current_state.en: China's new five-year informatization plan sets a 2030 target for largely completing a national blockchain network, with focused deployments in Yangtze River Delta trade and finance and large-scale use in Chengdu-Chongqing manufacturing and agriculture.
